title: Rav Chama bar Ashi

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:9 Rabbi Ba speaks in his name; Hyman suggests that the reading should be Rav Chiyya bar Ashi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:9 fully writes Rav Chama bar Ashi and, in the adjacent statement, Rav Chiyya bar Ashi. These full titles support Rav for the supplied abbreviation ר׳. Replacing Chama with Chiyya remains Hyman’s tentative proposal.

The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:9 paragraph writes Rabbi Ba in the name of Rav Chiyya bar Ashi and separately in the name of Rav Chama bar Ashi. Local full titles are supported. Hyman’s tentative replacement of Chama with Chiyya remains his suggestion rather than an identity harmonization; the current note stays verbatim.
